body:
Three fixes for the reported landing/deployment issues:

- **Left sidebar on the landing page**: registers lean's `site-page` condition and drops the `not-index` conditions on the left-column components (page-title, search, darkmode, reader-mode, spacer); `docs-explorer` moves `library-page` → `site-page`. Tag pages keep exactly the components they had before (`not-index` included them), which is why those become unconditional rather than `site-page`.
- **GitHub logo above the search bar**: ports lean's `page-title-github` icon link (`357076d6`), parameterized via `GITHUB_REPOSITORY` (automatic in Actions builds; hidden locally) so the template stays repo-agnostic.
- **Branch switcher on the main deployment**: no code needed — the existing `SEPO_COMMENTS_PREVIEW_SWITCHER=hover` knob (`47f76308`) is forwarded from repo variables by the deploy workflow; verified `data-preview-switcher="hover"` renders when set. The repo variable is being set alongside this PR.

Verified locally: landing shows the full sidebar with the GitHub icon, tag pages unchanged, `npm run check` + builds pass.
